approvals.quote: I always trust our own projects because the only two people working on them are you and I.
approvals.approving: Answering Claude Code's folder-trust dialog Yes, one record per lane folder (the per-lane trust-folder-<role> records).

approvals.quote: Yes.  Blanket trust all directories under C:\Projects so future projects are already approved for that dialog.
approvals.approving: Replacing the one-record-per-lane trust-folder records, for NEW folders, with this single record: on a session lane-restart relaunched, answer Claude Code's folder-trust dialog Yes (Down then Enter; the default is 'No, exit') for any folder STRICTLY UNDER C:\Projects, and for nothing else. The dialog must show 'Quick safety check', the line 'Accessing workspace:' and the line 'Yes, I trust this folder', and the folder on one row followed by a blank row; the folder must be a plain C:\ path (no UNC, no '..', no 8.3 short name), strictly under C:\Projects component by component (C:\Projects-evil and C:\ProjectsX do not qualify, nor does C:\Projects itself), and must equal its own canonical form on disk (a junction or symlink out of C:\Projects, or any alias, is refused). The risk was accepted knowingly: anything that can create a folder under C:\Projects is trusted. Every answer is written to .lane-state/folder-trust-answers.log (lane, resolved folder, time) and announced to the notify role. A dialog that mentions a secret is never answered. Expires 2027-04-22.
